description: Create a client workspace: one per client site an agency manages. Its email_to/slack_url/webhook_url are the defaults for every form in it whose own field is blank. Pro includes one, Business 50.

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.

email_to.description: Default comma-separated emails for the client's forms

webhook_url.description: Default HTTPS webhook URL (signed with each form's secret)

name: doorman_create_workspace
